instruction.text: What are the two main types of water biome called?

atoms.b: Saltwater biomes are also known as ((cement ++marine)) biomes.
They include any body of water with a high level of dissolved ((sugar ++salt)), such as the ocean, coral reefs and coastal biomes.

instruction.text: Select the four living things that you think can be found in marine biomes.

feedback.finish: These are just some examples of the plants and animals that can be found in marine biomes. They are very diverse places!

atoms.b: Freshwater biomes are bodies of water that contain less than 1% of ((sugar ++salt)). They can be found all over the world.
Over half of the water that we ((eat ++drink)) comes from freshwater biomes.

instruction.text: Freshwater biomes can be split into three categories. Match the descriptions to the categories.
